aliases.name: The Gun that Won the West
aliases.note: A Winchester advertising slogan from the 1920s, not a contemporary description.

capacity.sourceNote: Tube magazine under the barrel; the article gives 7 to 14 rounds across barrel lengths.
Tube magazine. The 1873 was the first Winchester offered in a rimfire chambering.

images.alt: A Winchester Model 1873 rifle lying on a wooden surface, seen from the left, with a walnut stock, a colour-cased receiver, an octagonal barrel and a loading lever below the trigger
images.caption: A Model 1873 with the octagonal barrel and the loading gate visible on the right of the receiver. The lever below the trigger guard operates the toggle-link action.

massEmpty.sourceNote: Published as 9.5 lb; 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly. The cited article publishes this for the Winchester rifle series as a whole, illustrated with an 1873; it is not stated for the 1873 specifically.

length.sourceNote: Published as 49.3 in; 1 in = 25.4 mm exactly. Published for the series rather than for this model.

barrelLength.sourceNote: Published as 30 in; 1 in = 25.4 mm exactly. Published for the series rather than for this model; the 1873 was catalogued with 20-, 24- and 30-inch barrels.
